item.title: Running Kali Linux Containers on a Linux Server with Docker
item.description: Kali Linux ships official OCI images under kalilinux/kali-rolling, kalilinux/kali-last-release, and kalilinux/kali-bleeding-edge. They are deliberately minimal, containing little beyond the base userland, so tooling is layered on top through Kali’s metapackages. That makes them well suited to disposable, reproducible assessment environments on a remote server: you get a clean toolchain per engagement, isolated from the host and from each other, without maintaining a full Kali VM. Use them only against systems you are authorized to test.
